claim: Separate the new R168 reference-token score from its saturated rejector, then test new identity evidence obtained by querying the reference as the target of the same frozen grounder.
cache_population: Exactly the 18,620 R165 ordinary directional records in the R168 seal. Compare the original independent baseline, old left/right only, new left/right only and the permuted new correction with left/right only. No support-overlap penalty or old Top-1 gate. Keep the historical empty slot for no physical candidate. All thresholds, sign terms, subject unaries, candidate membership and geometry/PCA are inherited. Rotate cached centered new-minus-old deltas exactly as in R168; the added per-role centering constant cancels upon recentering.
query_population: All 54 prior independent image-verified directional relation edges from R168, fixed by their archived row/edge membership. This is a previously examined mechanism panel, not an independent generalization set. Do not open private true identity before queries and mappings are sealed. Preserve unsupported edges and expose support denominators. No new target panel selection based on predictions.
rewrite: Use one independently addressable direct camera-horizontal edge. Preserve the original endpoint noun phrases and visibly attributed appearance spans while canonicalizing both B and D. B keeps the original subject and reads its companion reference tokens. C uses just the reference phrase as the grounding subject. D promotes that reference to the grounding subject, swapping LEFT and RIGHT. Other context beyond the individual edge is absent from both B and D. Mark conflicting predicates, ambiguous endpoints, unsupported coordinates, and non-singular or unresolved mentions as unsupported. Use no GT-derived words.
query_forward: Run the same frozen per-source model, matcher and original point-sample/RGB observation. A uses the archived common-bank scores. Recompute A's original natural reference-token and point-attention rank for the matched native-form identity comparison and assert exact topic and matching preconditions. B uses the same reference-token and point-attention score in its natural encoding. C and D use the same targeted R158 confidence and native geometry. Recompute language-conditioned query generation and downstream matching. Same-sample anchors are audited, query slots never identify the same object across texts. Reuse sampled points only; this prototype makes no claim of cached frozen backbones or RGB features.

association.support: Shared distinct input XYZ returns, axis-aligned original native boxes and original oriented region hypotheses. Use range-independent pair Jaccard of physical point occupancy, not learned appearance or query slots. Disallow ties for distinct physical candidates. Assign each donor to the highest compatible physical candidate, aggregate multiple donors with the best centered donor score plus log Jaccard, then recenter per role. A mapped arm uses the original bank and its role unary least changed.

identity_stage: For each A-D preserve natural top/rank/coverage, common-pool rank and accuracy, matched/no-link status, correct-to-wrong-transfer counts, and original-subject binding. Native identity uses the same annotation-seed ownership rule and common PCA convention. Compare all four on a paired supported subset plus all 54 attempts, and show physical frames and recordings. A and B keep the initial subject for the reference semantic readout. B's natural subject IoU is also reported as a canonicalization check.
joint_stage: Preseal the same-information independent and left/right-only joint decisions with all arms. Evaluate the joint endpoint only if a rewritten arm has more correct natural identities than the canonical original-subject reference-token arm and more correct mapped identities than both A and B on the same supported edges. Which variants pass is a mechanism screen, not fitted target-wide selection. Report C versus D even when only one passes. On any pass report same evidence, same bank, same subject prior and same geometry, independent versus one-edge joint Acc, mIoU, subject/ref/both identities and paired corrections/harms. No overlap penalty, source-calibrated rejection, additional reference branch, source retraining or FINAL access. Unlinked donors and roles have missing physical evidence rather than speculative matches.
source_audit: Inspect six new source calibration frames per platform from the sealed R168 120-frame roster, excluded from the earlier 12-role image spot audit. Prefer potential same-class distractors and spread by recording. Review full RGB and projected annotation inventory blind to proxy assignment and model results. Keep wrong/uncertain/missing boxes and record actual agreement. Source image judgments are descriptive only and never fit the new method.
stop: One complete cache comparison and one A-D identity panel. Allow no endpoint threshold tuning or expanded target replay for the new interface. Preserve R158+PCA as deployed, regardless of this diagnostic panel. Report scope and disposition after CPU auditing.
